By Mike Allen · Sep 24, 2026

🍂 Good Thursday afternoon. Today's newsletter, edited by Alex Fitzpatrick, is 528 words, a 2-min. read. Thanks to Carolyn DiPaolo for copy editing.

 
 
1 big thing: Meet Meta's AI handheld
 
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg reveals the Muse Charm at Meta Connect in Menlo Park, Calif., yesterday. Photo: Minh Connors/Bloomberg via Getty Images

Meta's new Muse Charm is a keychain-sized AI handheld device to bring the viral Muse assistant to the masses, Axios' Ina Fried reports.

  • The Tamagotchi-like gadget has a screen and a digital avatar representing Muse.
  • Meta says the Muse Charm will be available by December.

🎤 CEO Mark Zuckerberg said during yesterday's Meta Connect keynote: "We've packed a lot of technology in this little guy."

  • "So if you're not wearing [smart] glasses, this is going to be by far the fastest way to talk to your Muse and to show them what's going on around you."

🤖 Meta also announced new Muse capabilities, including live video chat, real-time voice conversations with custom voice options and an email address for each person's agent.

  • Zuckerberg said: "I expect that Muse is going to grow into the personal superintelligence that billions of people around the world are going to use to accomplish their goals and improve their lives."

The big picture: Other AI companies, including OpenAI, are also working on hardware based around their digital agents.

🤔 Reality check: Muse is also available through a smartphone app. It's unclear what advantages a dedicated gadget might offer.

  • Go deeper ... Meta's next VR headset.
 
 
2. 🎤 Macklemore announces "Free Palestine" tour
 
Screenshot: @macklemore/X

Rapper Macklemore announced a "Free Palestine" tour today, with stops in Dublin, Paris and London.

  • That's after he was dropped from Ed Sheeran's "Loop Tour" after making pro-Palestinian comments during a performance.

🤳 Macklemore wrote on X: "What happened to me is bigger than one artist or one stage. When the billionaire class can decide which voices are allowed on stage and which ones are too dangerous to hear, everyone should be paying attention."

  • "So we're going on tour. All proceeds will benefit organizations supporting the Palestinian people and movement."

What's next: Artists and U.S. dates are TBD, the rapper said on Instagram.

3. ⚡️ Catch me up
 
Image: CNN via @BrianStelter/X
  1. 🚫 Reporters for MS NOW, CNN and Politico were back on White House grounds this afternoon after a federal judge ordered the Trump administration to reinstate their access. The ruling didn't address the rotating TV pool. Get the latest.
  2. 🛰️ Google and SpaceX are set to launch an experimental satellite to test the idea of AI data centers in space, the N.Y. Times reports. Gift link.
  3. 🐼 China is sending two pandas to Zoo Atlanta after Beijing reclaimed four of them in 2024 amid diplomatic tensions, Chinese President Xi Jinping announced during his state visit today. Go deeper.
 
 
4. 🍗 1 for the road: KFC's new concept
 
Photo: Naheed Rajwani-Dharsi/Axios

Patio seating, a booth for special celebrations, lobby hosts and expanded menu options are part of a new concept that KFC is testing in McKinney, Texas, Axios Dallas' Naheed Rajwani-Dharsi reports.

  • A host greets visitors as they enter. Customers can order at a kiosk or with an employee. Dine-in orders are brought to the table.
Photo: Naheed Rajwani-Dharsi/Axios

🐓 There's also a display case with KFC merch, including socks, sweatshirts, phone cases and water bottles.

  • KFC U.S. president Catherine Tan-Gillespie tells Axios: "We basically imagined, 'If the Colonel was building this restaurant today, what would it look like?'"
